description: Bidirectional USB-PD 3.0 buck-boost power-bank IC. Negotiates PD source (discharge) and sink (charge) on a single USB-C port. External 4-switch H-bridge for the buck-boost stage; integrated charger control and LED bar driver.
name: ip2368
watch_out_for: Configuration straps set protocol behavior: BAT_NUM (R4) selects cell count (91k = 3S); V_SET (R6) selects per-cell termination voltage (10k = 4.20V); I_SET (R7) selects charge current ceiling. Verify resistor values against the latest IP2368 datasheet revision before fabrication.
